Hi Janice —

Quick reminder that your interview loop is scheduled for tomorrow, 9:00 AM PT. Attached is the day-of itinerary and the short coding prompt we usually use for the live pairing session.

If anything comes up overnight (fever, travel, connectivity), we can either:
- reschedule to the next available slot (we have openings Thu/Fri), or

No pressure — let me know as soon as you can and we’ll accommodate. If you prefer the take-home route I can send the instructions and an extended window for submission.

Best,

From: Janice Malik <janice.malik@gmail.com>

Subject: Re: Tomorrow 9am PT - interview plan (options if you're unwell)

Hi Marissa —

Thank you for the heads up. I woke up with a fever and body aches (38.8°C) and don’t feel comfortable doing a live video loop tomorrow morning. I’m very interested in the role and don’t want to skip the process — would the take-home + recorded walkthrough option work?

If so, a couple quick questions:
- How long is the take-home window?
- Are we allowed to use the internet and public libraries for research?
- Is there any preferred format for the recording (screen + audio, recorded meeting link, or a short Loom)?

If rescheduling is simpler for the team, I’m available Thu after 10am PT or Fri morning. I can provide a doctor’s note if needed — apologies for the late notice.

Thanks,
Janice

(On my phone, sorry for typos.)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Janice Malik <janice.malik@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Sep 2028 03:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tomorrow 9am PT - interview plan (options if you're unwell)

Hi Janice —

Thanks for letting us know and I’m sorry you’re feeling unwell. We’re happy to convert to the take-home + short recorded walkthrough so you don’t have to do the live video while you recover. Details below — I’m attaching the formal instructions as well.

Take-home + recorded walkthrough (option accepted):
- Prompt: same prompt as the live pairing (attached: coding-exercise-v2.pdf).
- Open-book: internet and public resources allowed. No copy/paste from proprietary sources; cite anything nontrivial.
- Time window: please submit code and recording within 72 hours from this email (deadline: 2028-09-07 03:08 PT). If you need more time, tell us and we’ll extend.
- Recording: screen + audio preferred (Loom, Zoom recording, or a shared video link). Try to keep the walkthrough to 20–30 minutes and highlight your approach, trade-offs, and where you’d optimize next.
- Reimbursement: we’ll add a $40 goodwill compensation for the change.

Panel logistics: Jonas and I will review asynchronously. If any follow-up live 1:1 is needed it will be scheduled after your submission.

If you prefer to reschedule instead, we have Thu (9/6) 10:30–12:00 PT and Fri (9/7) 09:00–11:00 PT open — let us know which you prefer.

Takecare and feel better — no need to provide a doctor’s note unless your HR asks later.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Engineer, Hiring Panel Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- takehome-instructions-janice.pdf (detailed instructions and rubrics)
